name: Parties
description: The vocabulary of organizations and people. Buyer, target, and advisor are instances of organization inside this one domain. The domain is the vocabulary they share. It is not any one of the firms.

entities.name: Organization
entities.description: A firm. Three instances cover the three sides of a deal.

entities.name: Person
entities.description: A person. An advisor and a shopper are instances, not kinds.

relationships.name: acts for
relationships.description: A person acts for an organization. The edge has no data of its own, so it stays a relationship. A role would make it an entity.
